Trace the expression that produces a variable inside a function.

Source: R/extendr-wrappers.R
gvv_trace_rs.Rd

Rust rewrite of the extraction half of rpkgkit:::get_var_value(): the definition environment is built from the formals of the function, its body is walked to record every assignment, and the target expression is resolved by substituting the known variables. The resolved expression is returned instead of its value, so that the final eval() runs in R and a failing evaluation keeps its original condition.

Usage

gvv_trace_rs(var_name, fmls, body, env)

Arguments

var_name

Name of the target variable.

fmls

Formals of the function, as returned by formals().

body

Body of the function, as returned by body().

env

Environment used to evaluate conditions and loop sequences.

Details

Returns a list with found (whether var_name is a parameter with a default or is assigned in the body) and expr (the resolved expression, NULL when it was not found).
